 * ***Transfer Pricing Techniques*** : Large multinational corporation often use transfer pricing techniques which involve manipulating prices charged among different subsidiary firms operating across multiple jurisdictions with intention minimizing overall taxation burden by shifting profit margins towards low - taxed jurisdiction
